contracts.source: eMemory press release: Trusted AI Agents Must Be Anchored in Silicon (10-14-2026)
contracts.signal: Release by PUFsecurity (a subsidiary of eMemory Technology): PUFsecurity and Arm have collaborated for years - in 2022 Arm selected PUFrt for the secure subsystem in its reference implementation of the Armv9 Confidential Compute Architecture; today PUFrt is part of the Runtime Security Engine (RSE) in Arm Neoverse CSS V3, the compute subsystem on which Arm AGI CPU (Arm's new data-center processor for agentic AI) is built, and the RSE serves as the chip's Root of Trust. PUFrt gives each chip a unique, unclonable device fingerprint derived from the silicon, so no root key needs to be injected in the factory.
contracts.date_signed: 2022 (Arm selected PUFrt for the Armv9 CCA reference implementation)
